items.title: 1.1.1.1 now supports post-quantum DNSSEC, all 2,420 bytes of it

sentences.en: 1.1.1.1 now supports post-quantum DNSSEC, all 2,420 bytes of it.
sentences.zh: 1.1.1.1现在支持后量子DNSSEC ，所有2,420字节。

sentences.en: 1.1.1.1 now validates DNSSEC signatures made with ML-DSA-44 , a post-quantum signature algorithm standardized by the National Institute of Standards and Technology (NIST) .
sentences.zh: 1.1.1.1现在验证使用ML-DSA-44制作的DNSSEC签名， ML-DSA-44是由美国国家标准与技术研究院（ NIST ）标准化的后量子签名算法。

sentences.en: This is a first step toward preparing DNSSEC for a future in which today’s signature algorithms are no longer secure.
sentences.zh: 这是为今天的签名算法不再安全的未来做好DNSSEC准备的第一步。

sentences.en: Cloudflare plans to achieve full post-quantum security by 2029 .
sentences.zh: Cloudflare计划到2029年实现全面的后量子安全。

sentences.en: Much of the work so far has focused on TLS, but public-key cryptography is used in many other systems, including DNSSEC.
sentences.zh: 到目前为止，大部分工作都集中在TLS上，但公钥加密被用于许多其他系统，包括DNSSEC。

sentences.en: While we began experimenting with post-quantum key agreement in TLS in 2019 and enabled support for all customers in 2022, post-quantum signatures have not yet received comparable testing in DNSSEC.
There is also some urgency.
Widespread client adoption of post-quantum TLS took years, partly because larger messages exposed assumptions and bugs in existing network software.
That experience showed why early large-scale testing matters.
We cannot wait until quantum computers become an immediate threat.
The problem is that post-quantum signatures are large.
Each ML-DSA-44 signature is 2,420 bytes, exceeding common DNS-over- UDP limits before the response includes anything else.

items.title: GitHub availability report: August 2026

sentences.en: GitHub availability report: August 2026.
sentences.zh: GitHub可用性报告： 2026年8月。

sentences.en: While we continue to make progress, August proved to be a challenging month for availability.
sentences.zh: 虽然我们继续取得进展，但事实证明， 8月是一个充满挑战的月份。

sentences.en: You can read more about these incidents in a blog post we published last month.
sentences.zh: 您可以在我们上个月发布的博客文章中进一步了解这些事件。

sentences.en: We are aggressively investing in both architectural improvements and moving to Azure, which will give us more capacity.
sentences.zh: 我们正在积极投资于架构改进和迁移到Azure ，这将为我们提供更多容量。

sentences.en: Meanwhile, we continue to see significant growth on our platform.
sentences.zh: 与此同时，我们的平台继续大幅增长。

sentences.en: We are prioritizing the most impactful work while minimizing risk, but as these incidents in August show, we cannot completely eliminate risk.
sentences.zh: 我们正在优先考虑最具影响力的工作，同时将风险降至最低，但正如8月份的这些事件所显示的那样，我们无法完全消除风险。

sentences.en: Ultimately, all the work needs to be done, and incidents give us an opportunity to adjust our priorities.
sentences.zh: 最终，所有的工作都需要完成，而事件让我们有机会调整我们的优先事项。

sentences.en: As repair items from these incidents, we ve made significant improvements to our capacity monitoring and management, retry policies that led to bigger impact, and resiliency improvements to core services.
sentences.zh: 作为这些事故的维修项目，我们对容量监控和管理进行了重大改进，重试了带来更大影响的策略，并改善了核心服务的弹性。

sentences.en: We ve also continued to make great progress across many durable work streams.
sentences.zh: 我们还在许多持久的工作流程中继续取得重大进展。

sentences.en: On August 11, GitHub ran a production MySQL primary from Azure for the first time.
sentences.zh: 8月11日， GitHub首次从Azure运行MySQL生产主体。

sentences.en: Client-observed write impact was minimal, and no customer impact occurred in the transition.
sentences.zh: 客户观察到的写入影响很小，过渡期间没有对客户产生影响。

sentences.en: We repeated the pattern with two more primaries on August 27.

items.title: Introducing Amazon EBS Volume Clones across AWS accounts

sentences.en: Introducing Amazon EBS Volume Clones across AWS accounts.
sentences.zh: 介绍跨AWS帐户的Amazon EBS卷克隆。

sentences.en: Last year, we introduced Volume Clones of Amazon Elastic Block Store (Amazon EBS) , a new capability that lets you create instant point-in-time copies of your EBS volumes within the same Availability Zone.
sentences.zh: 去年，我们推出了Amazon Elastic Block Store (Amazon EBS)的卷克隆，这是一项新功能，允许您在同一可用区内创建EBS卷的即时时间点副本。

sentences.en: Today, we are extending Volume Clones with cross-account copy, so you can create copies of your EBS volumes into other AWS accounts and optionally re-encrypt them with an AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS) key in the target account.
sentences.zh: 今天，我们将使用跨帐户副本扩展卷克隆，因此您可以将EBS卷的副本创建到其他AWS帐户，并可选择使用目标帐户中的AWS密钥管理服务(AWS KMS)密钥对其进行重新加密。

sentences.en: With this new feature, you can use your latest application data to develop, test, and experiment in a secondary environment, while protecting and isolating the information in the production environment.
sentences.zh: 借助此新功能，您可以使用最新的应用程序数据在辅助环境中进行开发、测试和实验，同时保护和隔离生产环境中的信息。

sentences.en: For example, you can create copies of a production environment to refresh test and development environments set up in separate accounts with the desired EBS encryption.
sentences.zh: 例如，您可以创建生产环境的副本，以便使用所需的EBS加密刷新在单独帐户中设置的测试和开发环境。

sentences.en: Copy EBS volumes across AWS accounts in action To create a copy of an EBS volume across accounts, the owners of the volume can first grant the target account access to their volume in AWS Resource Access Manager (RAM) , which provides a way to share resources across AWS accounts or within an AWS Organization.
sentences.zh: 跨AWS帐户复制EBS卷的实际操作要跨帐户创建EBS卷的副本，卷的所有者可以首先在AWS资源访问管理器(RAM)中授予目标帐户对其卷的访问权限，这提供了一种跨AWS帐户或在AWS组织内共享资源的方法。

sentences.en: Then, from the target account, they can locate the volume they have access to create a copy of it.
sentences.zh: 然后，从目标帐户中，他们可以找到他们有权访问的卷，以创建该卷的副本。

sentences.en: To get started, choose Share volume for the volume you want to share with the target account in the Amazon EBS console .
sentences.zh: 若要开始，请在Amazon EBS控制台中选择要与目标帐户共享的卷的“共享卷”。

sentences.en: Share the volume with other AWS accounts by adding it to existing resource shares, or create a new resource share in the AWS RAM console.
sentences.zh: 通过将其添加到现有资源共享与其他AWS帐户共享卷，或在AWS RAM控制台中创建新的资源共享。

sentences.en: For more details, refer to the AWS RAM User Guide .
sentences.zh: 有关更多详细信息，请参阅AWS RAM用户指南。

sentences.en: You can now see confirmation that the volume has been shared in the Volume sharing tab of the volume detail page.
sentences.zh: 现在，您可以在卷详细信息页面的卷共享选项卡中看到该卷已共享的确认。

sentences.en: A target account must accept the resource share on the RAM console.
sentences.zh: 目标帐户必须接受RAM控制台上的资源共享。

items.title: Kubernetes v1.37: Introducing Node Lifecycle Conditions

sentences.en: Kubernetes v1.37: Introducing Node Lifecycle Conditions.
Kubernetes has many ways to describe what is happening on a Node.
Readiness, taints, Pod state, labels, annotations, and provider-specific APIs each expose part of the picture.
What has been missing is a shared, Kubernetes-owned way to say that a Node is draining , undergoing maintenance, or undergoing Graceful Node Shutdown .

Kubernetes v1.37 introduces five well-known Node conditions that provide that description: DrainInProgress Drained MaintenancePlanned MaintenanceInProgress GracefulNodeShutdownInProgress The new Node lifecycle conditions Condition What it reports DrainInProgress The Node is actively being drained according to the administrator's chosen drain criteria.
Drained The Node has reached the drain criteria selected by the administrator.
MaintenancePlanned The Node is expected to undergo a change in the future.
MaintenanceInProgress The Node is actively undergoing maintenance.
GracefulNodeShutdownInProgress Graceful Node Shutdown is determined to be in progress on the Node.
Maintenance can include hardware or software rollout, remediation, decommissioning, or debugging.
Whether maintenance requires a drain depends on its impact.
A Kubernetes upgrade usually should follow a drain, while a kernel live patch might not need one.

sentences.en: Analysis of two skeletons reveals tooth wear and traces of psychoactive substance in what may be earliest known evidence for human drug taking What may be the earliest known evidence for human drug taking has been traced to ancient Indonesian foragers who sucked on mind-altering nuts as long as 25,000 years ago.

sentences.en: Analysis of two exceptionally rare skeletons from the Indonesian island of Sulawesi revealed dramatic tooth wear and traces of a psychoactive substance in the individuals’ remaining teeth, suggesting they routinely sucked on hard, abrasive betel nuts.
sentences.zh: 对来自印度尼西亚苏拉威西岛的两具异常罕见的骨骼的分析显示，这些人的剩余牙齿中存在剧烈的牙齿磨损和精神活性物质的痕迹，这表明他们经常吸食坚硬的槟榔。
